title: Apple's Stock Set To Trade Below 200-day Moving
text:
Apple's Stock Set To Trade Below 200-day Moving Average First Time Since July 2016 -- MarketWatch 
DOW JONES & COMPANY, INC. 9:09 AM ET 2/5/2018 
Symbol Last Price Change 
AAPL 160.5down 0 (0%) 
QUOTES AS OF 04:15:00 PM ET 02/02/2018 
Shares of Apple Inc.(AAPL) fell 0.9% in premarket trade, putting it on track to trade below its 200-day moving average for the first time since July 28, 2016. The stock, which entered its first official correction in 15 months after closing Friday 10.5% below its Jan. 18 record close of $179.26, was changing hands at $159.10 ahead of the open, while the 200-day MA comes in at $159.56. The last time the stock traded below the 200-day MA, which many chart watchers view as a dividing line between longer-term uptrends and downtrends, was July 28, 2016, while the last close was July 27, 2016. Apple's(AAPL) stock has lost 7.0% over the past three months, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average has gained 8.4%. 

-Tomi Kilgore For more from MarketWatch: http://www.marketwatch.com/newsviewer
